start.card:
Two chocolate bars are exactly the same size. One is cut into 9 pieces, the other into 7.
Which is bigger: 5 pieces of the 9-piece bar (5/9) or 4 pieces of the 7-piece bar (4/7)? Make a guess first.
start.title: Which is bigger, 5/9 or 4/7?

afterGuess.card: You guessed "5/9 is bigger". Let's test it. Press "Cut the bars" to cut one bar into 9 pieces and the other into 7.
afterGuess.title: Which is bigger, 5/9 or 4/7?

after.card:
Change the sliders to compare other fractions. Do the tiny-piece counts match what the red gap shows?
To compare fractions, make the pieces the same size. A bigger number on the bottom means smaller pieces.
after.title: Which is bigger, 5/9 or 4/7?
